title: Version bump triggers recopy of default skills
scenario: Memory-fs workspace stamped with skillsBundleVersion 20; bundle says 21 with a changed SKILL.md and a stray file in .reltio/reltio-agent/skills/default. Run syncReltioAgentAssets. Existing test-workflow-skills-sync.cjs only runs a fresh sync and an equal-stamp sync.
expected: skills/default is deleted and recopied from the bundle (stray file gone) and the stamp skillsBundleVersion becomes 21.

title: Equal stamp skips copy for skills and packs
scenario: Sync twice with unchanged bundle versions; between runs write a marker file into .reltio/reltio-agent/skills/default and velocity-packs. Count fs writes and deletes on the second run (countWrites pattern from test-match-rule-generation-skill.cjs).
expected: Second run does not delete or recopy either folder: marker files survive and no managed-layer writes occur.

title: Skills and packs versions are tracked independently
scenario: Stamp has skills 20 and packs 1; bundle bumps only skillsBundleVersion to 21. Put a marker file in velocity-packs. Sync, then read .sync-state.json.
expected: skills/default recopied, velocity-packs untouched (marker survives), stamp shows skills 21 and packs 1 preserved, ownedAgentFiles retained.

title: Missing managed folder is restored when stamp is current
scenario: Fresh sync, then delete .reltio/reltio-agent/velocity-packs while .sync-state.json stays current. Sync again.
expected: velocity-packs is recopied from resources/velocity-packs although versions match; skills/default is not rewritten.

title: force option recopies despite current stamp
scenario: Fresh sync, edit a file inside skills/default, run syncReltioAgentAssets(context, {force:true}) (the Resync command path).
expected: Edited managed file is restored to bundled content; stamp stays at bundled versions. A non-forced equal-stamp run leaves the edit alone.

title: skills/workspace override layer is never written or deleted by sync
scenario: Workspace holds skills/workspace/<playbook>/SKILL.md override, a team-only skill folder and a loose note file. Run fresh sync, version-bump sync, forced sync and install=false opt-out. Snapshot the skills/workspace tree bytes before and after each.
expected: skills/workspace tree is byte-identical after every run, including opt-out. test-match-rule-generation-skill.cjs asserts this for one override in one flow; this row pins all sync modes.

title: Override lands in installed copy, not in the managed default mirror
scenario: Override skills/workspace/match-groups-from-concept/SKILL.md (same name). Sync. Compare .reltio/reltio-agent/skills/default/<playbook>/SKILL.md with .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md. Override precedence itself is in test-match-rule-generation-skill.cjs.
expected: Managed default copy keeps bundled content (pure mirror of skills/reltio-default); the installed .claude copy shows override content.

title: Install-skills opt-out removes only owned paths
scenario: Sync with reltio.installAgentSkills true, add a user file in .claude/skills and a team rule in .claude/rules, set the setting false and sync through syncReltioAgentAssets. syncAgentSkills level is in test-match-rule-generation-skill.cjs.
expected: All stamp-owned paths vanish, ownedAgentFiles becomes [], user files remain, and the .reltio/reltio-agent managed layer is still synced.

title: Occupied target path is reported as conflict, not overwritten
scenario: Pre-create .claude/skills/<bundled-name>/ with user content not in the stamp, then sync. See test-match-rule-generation-skill.cjs.
expected: Report.conflicts lists the path, user content is unchanged, path is absent from ownedAgentFiles in the stamp.

title: Broken bundled or override skill is reported as invalid
scenario: Cases: no SKILL.md, missing name, name with uppercase, double hyphen or 65 chars, description over 1024 chars, override renaming the default. Assert skillProblem and resolveSkills output. Partly in test-match-rule-generation-skill.cjs.
expected: Each case yields one invalid message naming playbook and reason; the skill is not installed and the default is not silently substituted. 64-char name and 1024-char description are accepted.

title: Missing or incomplete assets file skips sync safely
scenario: Run sync with (a) no resources/reltio-agent-assets.json, (b) JSON missing velocityPacksBundleVersion, (c) invalid JSON, (d) no workspace folders.
expected: Each returns {conflicts:[],invalid:[]} without throwing and creates no .reltio/reltio-agent directory or stamp.

title: Manifest byte counts and assets versions stay consistent
scenario: Reuse validateVelocityPacks, then add per-pack check: declared bytes equal statSync size of each BusinessConfig.json; assets JSON has non-empty skillsBundleVersion and velocityPacksBundleVersion. Existing test-skills-and-enablement-packs-library.cjs checks only the aggregate sum.
expected: Per-pack declared bytes equal file size, with the failing pack id named; both version fields present.

title: Every bundled skill passes agent naming rules
scenario: Run readBundledSkills on the real skills/reltio-default folder, assert invalid is empty, names equal reltio-<folder> and are unique. Already asserted in test-match-rule-generation-skill.cjs.
expected: invalid=[] and names unique; a skill added with bad frontmatter fails the gate.

title: Large skills tree sync is idempotent and cheap on rerun
scenario: Seed memory-fs with all real skills/reltio-default files, sync twice, count fs writes on the second run and measure elapsed time.
expected: Second run writes 0 managed-skill files (converge writes only differing files) and finishes within a few seconds in memory-fs.

title: Concurrent sync requests are serialized
scenario: Start a normal sync, an identical second sync and a forced sync concurrently with a slow fs stub. Section 6 of test-workflow-skills-sync.cjs covers this.
expected: Identical request shares the running promise; forced run starts only after the first ends; no interleaved delete and copy.

title: Sync never touches files outside owned paths and .reltio
scenario: Workspace with user AGENTS.md without markers, an unterminated block marker, customer .cursor rules and .github workflows. Run sync as cursor, vscode and other hosts. Related coverage in test-workflow-skills-sync.cjs.
expected: User files byte-identical; unterminated block leaves the file unchanged; only stamp-owned paths, legacy-marker files and emptied parent folders are removed.

title: Nested skill paths and CRLF frontmatter install correctly
scenario: Run syncAgentSkills with a skill containing nested references/ files and a CRLF SKILL.md; also a Windows-drive-style workspace URI via the stub.
expected: Nested files land at expected relative paths, owned entries use forward slashes, CRLF frontmatter parses name and description.
